name: fld_isSquare_three_zmod_iff
statement: (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (hp : 3 < p) : IsSquare (3 : ZMod p) ↔ p % 12 = 1 ∨ p % 12 = 11
closed: ∀ (p : ℕ) [Fact p.Prime] (hp : 3 < p), IsSquare (3 : ZMod p) ↔ p % 12 = 1 ∨ p % 12 = 11
informal: 3 is a quadratic residue mod a prime p > 3 iff p ≡ ±1 (mod 12) — quadratic reciprocity (ZMod.exists_sq_eq_prime_iff_of_mod_four_eq_one / _three) reduces to whether p is a square mod 3, i.e. p ≡ 1 mod 3, with a sign flip when p ≡ 3 mod 4; combine residues mod 4 and mod 3.
type: ∀ (p : ℕ) [inst : Fact (Nat.Prime p)], 3 < p → (IsSquare 3 ↔ p % 12 = 1 ∨ p % 12 = 11)
